lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns across the central flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a rectangular coordinate-like lattice.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, defined by a distinct highlight on the superior edge and a shadow gradient on the inferior edge.
